Olga / team / Lia — I reviewed the two alternatives. Below is the recommended publicity clause (concise, signable, and consistent with our standard Order Form practice). I attach a one-page redline that inserts this language into the MSA where you indicated.

Suggested publicity clause (for insertion into Section 8.x of the MSA):

"Customer agrees that Redwood may identify Customer as a customer of Redwood Inference and use Customer's name and logo in Redwood's marketing materials, including the Redwood website, product one-pagers, and press releases, provided that Redwood obtains Customer's prior written approval of the final materials (which approval shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed). Customer may designate an embargo date during which Redwood shall not publish or distribute such materials. For avoidance of doubt, any use of Customer logos will comply with Customer's brand guidelines; Redwood will use only approved logo files delivered by Customer."

Confidentiality carveout for reference language (to add to Section 4.x):

"Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in this Agreement, Customer may provide written consent for Redwood to publish limited, non-confidential performance metrics or short descriptive statements about Customer's use of the Service. Such consent shall be scoped in writing and may be revoked."

Evidence required before publication (we will require one of the following):
- signed logo-release or a signed exhibit attached to the Order Form, OR
- an e-mail from an identified PR contact authorizing the specific asset(s) and final text, OR
- a DocuSign-signed public quote approval sheet.

If Novacorp is only requesting a logo/reference mention (no case study), the approval process can be lightweight — logo files + PR contact + one confirmation e-mail are sufficient. If they want a case study or quotes, we will ask for a short approval turnaround (48–72 hours) and a final sign-off on the case study draft.

I have attached: publicity_clause_suggested_redline.docx (one page), and a short sample "logo release" that we can use as an exhibit to the Order Form.

Olga: happy to review the Order Form redline before we send it to Lia for signature.

— Markus
